description: This file contains board-specific configuration and initialization code for an STM32F4-based board using ChibiOS, including PAL setup, clock initialization, and placeholder functions for SD card and MMC detection.

methods.name: __early_init
methods.description: Performs early system initialization, specifically clock setup.

methods.name: sdc_lld_is_card_inserted
methods.description: Checks if an SD card is inserted; currently a placeholder returning true.

methods.name: sdc_lld_is_write_protected
methods.description: Checks if SD card is write protected; currently a placeholder returning false.

methods.name: mmc_lld_is_card_inserted
methods.description: Checks if MMC card is inserted; currently a placeholder returning true.

methods.name: mmc_lld_is_write_protected
methods.description: Checks if MMC card is write protected; currently a placeholder returning false.

methods.description: Overrides for pin configuration, currently empty.
